title: THE STANDARD THAT DOES NOT SHIFT

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text:
"'Every value is to be set according to the sanctuary shekel, twenty
gerahs to the shekel'" - Lev 27:25 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
All these valuations were measured by one fixed standard: the sanctuary
shekel. There was an official, unchanging weight against which everything
was assessed. No one could use a lighter measure to cheat, or a heavier
one to defraud. The standard was set, and it did not move.

In a world where merchants often kept two sets of weights — a heavy one
for buying and a light one for selling — a fixed, trustworthy standard was
a mercy. Everyone knew where they stood.

Dear reader, we live in an age that increasingly insists there is no fixed
standard for anything — that truth shifts with the times, that right and
wrong are whatever each person decides. It can leave us disoriented,
never quite sure what to measure our lives against.

But God does not change, and neither does His truth. Scripture says the
grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God endures
forever (Isa 40:8). Jesus said heaven and earth will pass away, but My
words will never pass away (Matt 24:35). He is described as the same
yesterday and today and forever (Heb 13:8).

There is deep security in an unchanging standard. When everything around
you feels uncertain and every opinion seems up for grabs, God's truth
remains a fixed point you can build your life on.

Measure your life today against the sanctuary shekel that never shifts —
the unchanging word of the unchanging God.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What "standard" am I measuring my life against?
2. Do I find security in God's unchanging truth, or drift with opinion?
3. Where do I need a fixed point in a shifting season?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Father, thank You that You never change and Your truth endures forever.
In a shifting world, anchor my life to the fixed standard of Your word.
Amen.
